**Note:** CMIS application codes 1–3 are OIF 400ZR (CFEC); amplified vs unamplified is split at app code **0x01** vs **0x02**. OpenZR+ optical and penalty rows are tied to CMIS codes **4–14** (same application index as the electrical and OpenZR+ tables). Penalties for OpenZR+ appl modes **1–3** are not assigned here because those penalty sources do not appear in the pool and CMIS 1–3 are OIF, not OpenZR+. Generic worst-case powers (21.6 W, etc.) are module-wide and were not used per mode in favor of the electrical characteristics table.
